description: Royal Moroccan Air Force Mirage F1EH brought down over Western Sahara and exhibited as a war trophy by the Polisario Front at Rabuni in the Sahrawi refugee camps near Tindouf. Recorded by Wrecks and Relics Online as a wreck rather than a complete airframe and refreshed 19 March 2025. A 1996 photograph on the Northrop F-5 Enthusiast Page shows an F-5A and an F-5E at the same museum but neither has been confirmed since.
museum_name: Musee de l Armee Populaire de Liberation Sahraouie
